name: Club VGL
creator: Varneon
description: Club VGL is a realistic-looking nightclub world made by Varneon, made public in December 2018. Its name stands for Varneon's Gaming Lounge, and the map includes a dance floor with working lighting, a private catwalk area with a central dance pole, and lockable rooms with jacuzzis. It has been kept updated over the years and remains a recognizable nightclub-style hangout in VRChat.
